### Your Gifts Are for Other People
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-may-26-2025.html
Passage: 1 Peter 4:10
Points:
- God has uniquely equipped each believer with abilities intended to contribute to others.
- Personal talents are not given for selfish gain, but for the benefit and blessing of the community.
- Withholding your God-given talents deprives other people of the support they need.
- Living to serve others with your skills brings glory to God and advances His kingdom.

### When a Hobby Brings New Hope
Author: Sandi Swiridoff
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-7-2018.html
Passage: 1 Peter 4:10
Points:
- Everyday skills and creative hobbies are gifts entrusted to believers by God.
- Talents are not meant to be kept to oneself, but shared to encourage and bless others.
- Faithfulness in small, simple acts of service can be multiplied by God into far-reaching impact.
- Serving others with everyday talents fulfills biblical stewardship and brings glory to God.
